description: This file defines a Python package for generating random data, specifically for creating RDDs with samples from various distributions in PySpark's MLlib. It includes functions for generating RDDs of floats and vectors with samples from uniform, normal, log-normal, Poisson, exponential, and gamma distributions, along with helper decorators and a class encapsulating these methods.

classes.name: RandomRDDs
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate RDDs of random samples from various distributions, including methods for creating RDDs of floats and vectors.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: A decorator that converts an RDD of Vectors into an RDD of numpy.ndarray by applying toArray() on each Vector.

methods.name: uniformRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of i.i.d. samples from the uniform distribution U(0.0, 1.0).

methods.name: normalRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of i.i.d. samples from the standard normal distribution.

methods.name: logNormalRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of i.i.d. samples from the log-normal distribution with specified mean and std.

methods.name: poissonRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of i.i.d. samples from the Poisson distribution with specified mean.

methods.name: exponentialRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of i.i.d. samples from the exponential distribution with specified mean.

methods.name: gammaRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of i.i.d. samples from the Gamma distribution with specified shape and scale.

methods.name: uniformVectorRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of vectors containing i.i.d. samples from the uniform distribution, with each vector of specified size.

methods.name: normalVectorRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of vectors containing i.i.d. samples from the standard normal distribution.

methods.name: logNormalVectorRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of vectors containing i.i.d. samples from the log-normal distribution.

methods.name: poissonVectorRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of vectors containing i.i.d. samples from the Poisson distribution.

methods.name: exponentialVectorRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of vectors containing i.i.d. samples from the exponential distribution.

methods.name: gammaVectorRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of vectors containing i.i.d. samples from the Gamma distribution.
